claims.claim: More than 3,000 residents were displaced during the Israeli operation in Hebron.
claims.episode_span: More than 3,000 residents had been displaced during the raid and many began returning to damaged homes.
claims.source_title: Israeli army withdraws from Hebron after operation displaces thousands of Palestinians
claims.supporting_quote: The operation had emptied a neighbourhood in the West Bank 's largest city where the two gunmen had lived. AFP journalists witnessed residents returning to their homes on Monday after the military left.

claims.claim: The war in Sudan has displaced 13 million people and killed as many as 200,000.
claims.episode_span: The war between Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces has displaced 13 million people and killed as many as 200,000.
claims.source_title: As aid situation worsens, displaced Sudanese worry about warnings of famine
claims.supporting_quote: The fighting between the SAF and the RSF has killed as many as 200,000 people, according to aid workers. The war has also displaced 13 million people and led to famine in parts of the country.

claims.claim: Indian bonds posted their strongest gains in six months on Monday.
claims.episode_span: Indian bonds posted their strongest gains in six months on Monday after crude oil prices extended losses.
claims.source_title: Indian Bonds Rally as Oil Falls, Higher Yields Attract Buyers
claims.supporting_quote: Indian bonds gained the most in six months on Monday as crude oil prices extended losses, easing inflation concerns for the fuel-importing nation.

claims.claim: Rwanda reached an agreement to locally assemble more than 200 electric buses.

claims.supporting_quote: The plan to locally assemble more than 200 electric buses under an agreement involving Chinese firm Chery and Ecofleet Solutions is a welcome step in the country's shift towards cleaner transport.

claims.claim: Arrests for illegal crossings in California have fallen more than 93 percent from the previous peak.
